source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.5 with the second Fig. 3.16, Fig. 3.17 and Example 3.5 (PDF 67-68).

blocks.text: Hum dekh chuke hain ke translational motion (seedhi line mein chalna) mein linear momentum important role ada karta hai. Isi tarah rotational motion (apne axis par ghoomna) mein ek aur quantity, angular momentum, important hai.
Agar koi particle is tarah chale ke kisi reference axis ke hisaab se us ki angular position badalti rahe, to us particle ke paas us axis ke gird angular momentum hai.
blocks.title: Angular momentum

blocks.text: Mass m ka particle velocity v aur momentum p se chal raha hai (Fig. 3.16). Origin O ke hisaab se us ka angular momentum L:

blocks.alt: Origin O se magenta teer r mass m ke particle tak. m se neela teer p oopar daen taraf, r ki dashed barhai hui line se angle (kona) θ par. p ki line peeche dashed barhai gayi hai, aur O se us par dashed perpendicular (90° par) par r sin θ likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.16 (is number ki doosri figure): O ke gird particle ka angular momentum L = r x p (kitab ki figure ke mutabiq original drawing).
blocks.long_description: Kitab Fig. 3.16 ka number do baar chhapti hai: topic 3.4 mein rigid body (sakht cheez jo shakal na badle) ke liye aur yahan is figure ke liye.

blocks.text: L ki magnitude (kitna bara) rp sinθ hai. r sinθ woh perpendicular faasla hai jo O se p ki line tak hai (“momentum ka baazu”). Agar p seedha O ki taraf ya O se door ho (θ = 0) to yeh faasla zero aur L zero. L ki direction r aur p wale plane ke perpendicular hai (right hand rule).
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Figure 3.16 ka number do baar chhapti hai: topic 3.4 mein rigid body ke liye aur yahan angular momentum wali is figure ke liye. Is doosri figure ka apna alag number hona chahiye; figure khud sahi hai.
Yahan r us lamhe particle ka position vector hai (O se). Angular momentum vector hai; is ki magnitude:

blocks.text_alt: L = rp sinθ = m rv sinθ

blocks.text: θ, r aur p ke beech angle hai. L ki direction r aur p wale plane ke perpendicular hai, aur vector product ke right hand rule se milti hai. Angular momentum ka SI unit kg m² s⁻¹ ya J s hai.
Agar particle radius r ke daire mein uniform (ek jaisi) angular velocity ω se chal raha ho to r aur tangential velocity ke beech angle 90° hai. Is liye:

blocks.text_alt: Lekin v = rω   is liye L = mr²ω

blocks.text: (a) mein sphere golden teer ki direction mein ghoom raha hai. Is ki angular velocity aur angular momentum rotation (ghoomna) ke axis ke saath upar maane jate hain, jaisa (b) mein right hand rule dikhata hai.
blocks.title: For Your Information

blocks.alt: (a) Vertical (seedha khara) axis par neela sphere, us ke gird golden mura teer rotation ki direction (rukh) dikhata hai, aur teer L axis ke saath oopar. (b) Daayan haath jis ki ungliyan usi direction mein mudi hain (golden teer), aur angutha teer L ke saath oopar.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 67): ghoomta sphere aur L aur ω ke liye right-hand rule (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Sphere jis taraf ghoom raha hai, daayen haath ki ungliyan usi taraf modein; angootha upar aata hai. Is liye ω aur L dono axis ke saath upar hain.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Ab ek symmetric rigid body lein jo centre of mass se guzarne wale fixed axis par ghoom rahi hai (Fig. 3.17). Object ka har particle usi axis ke gird daire mein angular velocity ω se ghoomta hai. Mass mᵢ wale particle ke angular momentum ki magnitude mᵢvᵢrᵢ hai, aur Lᵢ ki direction ω wali hai. Chunke vᵢ = rᵢω, is liye i-wen particle ka angular momentum mᵢrᵢ²ω hai. Sab particles ka jor poore object ka angular momentum hai:
Yahan I rigid body ka axis ke gird moment of inertia hai.

blocks.alt: Gulabi disc apne centre (beech ka point) se guzarti vertical chhari ke gird ghoomti hai, disc par mura teer yeh dikhata hai. Daayan haath chhari pakarta hai, angutha oopar, aur gehra teer ω chhari ke saath oopar. Disc par axis se particle m_i tak line r_i, aur m_i par tangent ke saath velocity teer v_i.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.17: Centre of mass se guzarte fixed axis ke gird ghoomta symmetric (dono taraf ek jaisa) rigid body (kitab ki Figure 3.17 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Disc ka har particle mᵢ apne faasle rᵢ par vᵢ = rᵢω se ghoomta hai aur us ka angular momentum mᵢrᵢ²ω hai. Sab ki direction ek hai: axis ke saath upar, jaisa daayen haath ka angootha dikhata hai. Sab ko jama karein to L = Iω.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
Example 3.5
blocks.problem: Zameen ka mass 6.00 × 10²⁴ kg aur Suraj se faasla r = 1.50 × 10¹¹ m hai. North Star ki taraf se dekhein to Zameen Suraj ke gird counter-clockwise ghoomti hai. Farz karein Zameen saal (3.16 × 10⁷ s) mein ek dafa circular orbit poora karti hai. Suraj ke gird Zameen ka orbital angular momentum nikalein.
steps: Ek saal mein Zameen daire ka gher 2πr tay karti hai, is liye orbital speed vₒ = 2πr/t
Orbital angular momentum Lₒ = mvₒr = m(2πr/t)r = 2πr²m/t
Lₒ ≈ 2.7 × 10⁴⁰ kg m² s⁻¹ (kitab 2.67 × 10⁴⁰ likhti hai; in number se 2.68 × 10⁴⁰ banta hai)
blocks.answer: Lₒ ≈ 2.7 × 10⁴⁰ kg m² s⁻¹; sign positive hai kyunke rotation counter-clockwise hai.

blocks.prompt: Cycle ke pahiye ka angular momentum 10 kg m² s⁻¹ aur angular velocity 2 rad s⁻¹ hai; us ka moment of inertia nikalein. Dikhayein ke daire mein ghoomte particle ke liye L = Iω hai.
blocks.explanation: I = L/ω = 10 / 2 = 5 kg m². Daire mein particle ke liye L = mrv aur v = rω, to L = mr²ω; ek particle ka moment of inertia I = mr² hai, is liye L = Iω, bilkul rigid body jaisi shakal.

items: L = r × p; magnitude rp sinθ = mrv sinθ; direction right hand rule se r aur p ke perpendicular; unit kg m² s⁻¹ = J s.
Daire mein particle: L = mrv = mr²ω. Rigid body: L = Iω, axis ke saath.
Example 3.5: Zameen ka orbital angular momentum ≈ 2.7 × 10⁴⁰ kg m² s⁻¹.
